{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: no QA rows exist (i.e., no rows with revenue = '999999.99')
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA rows:", len(qa_rows))

# Check if any QA rows are in the loyal group
qa_in_loyal = qa_rows[qa_rows['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print("QA rows in loyal group:", len(qa_in_loyal))"}
